title: Hiring Managers are Judging You on These Things (I hired 10,000 people)
description:
What are hiring managers looking for in a candidate?  After hiring over 10,000 people, I’ve seen it all, and today, I’m breaking down what hiring managers want, what recruiters look for, and the subtle ways you’re being judged during the hiring process (often without realizing it).

If you’re trying to figure out how to get a job faster, this video is packed with practical career advice and job interview tips to help you stand out.
